kg.summary: 检索到 3 类证据、2 行背景知识（来源独立性=NOT_ESTABLISHED）。
kg.source: project Neo4j and MongoDB via MCP

evidence.cypher: MATCH (g:SLCGene) WHERE g.name IN $genes RETURN g.name AS gene, g.ProteinFunction AS protein_function, g.ProteinAliases AS aliases, g.Transport_type AS transport_type ORDER BY g.name LIMIT 8

MATCH (g:SLCGene)-[r]-(n) WHERE g.name IN $genes AND type(r)<>'HAS_SEQUENCE' RETURN g.name AS gene,type(r) AS relationship,labels(n) AS target_labels,n.name AS target,properties(n) AS target_properties ORDER BY g.name,type(r),n.name LIMIT 16

MATCH (g:SLCGene)-[:IS_SOURCE]->(e:RelaEvent)<-[:IS_TARGET]-(d:Disease) WHERE g.name IN $genes OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Pathway)-[:IS_MEDIATOR]->(e) RETURN g.name AS gene, p.name AS pathway, e.rel_AB AS rel_AB, e.rel_BC AS rel_BC, CASE WHEN e.rel_AB = e.rel_BC THEN 'PROMOTION' ELSE 'SUPPRESSION' END AS gene_disease_effect, d.name AS disease, d.diseaseSort AS disease_sort, e.paper_dois AS paper_dois ORDER BY CASE WHEN toLower(d.name) CONTAINS toLower($cancer) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, d.name, g.name LIMIT 16
